title: Be brave enough to kill the inner tyrant
summary: This meets the urge to look brave while arrogance still runs the house. The line says the real warrior subdues inner ego and redeems life through praise.
takeaway: Fight the ego, not the room.
lifeApplication: Before proving your strength to someone else, notice what inside still needs conquest. Use praise as the weapon before you use your voice.

source.shortMeaning: Real courage subdues inner ego and lets praise redeem life.
source.lifeApplication: When conflict sharpens you, aim first at the inner tyrant.

evidence.coreClaim: Real courage subdues inner ego and lets praise redeem life.
evidence.turn: Measure courage by how deeply ego is subdued.
evidence.practicalImplication: Before proving your strength to someone else, notice what inside still needs conquest. Use praise as the weapon before you use your voice.
